description: Targeted hardware-validation suite: inputs that exercise the models' distinguishing cases and the boundaries the earlier NVIDIA measurements did not cover (minimum alignment exponents, signed zeros, subnormals, TF32's exponent range, H100 TF32 MMA), with the outputs the Lean models predict. See targeted-validation.md.

conventions.block: d = c + sum_i a_i * b_i for one output element; a_i, b_i are input words in k order, c and d binary32 words.
conventions.words: hex; fp16/bf16 16-bit, tf32 the 19-bit tf19 word (a_fp32_register / b_fp32_register give the 32-bit register words, low 13 bits zero), binary32 and xf32 32-bit, fp8 8-bit FNUZ.
conventions.blocks: NVIDIA: k is split into contiguous block FMAs of size fma_size_K, the FP32 output of each block FMA the c of the next. AMD: blocks of N_FMA, chained the same way.
conventions.zero_fill: On an instruction with a larger k, place the vector in k = 0..len-1 and zeros elsewhere (a block FMA whose products are all zero returns c unchanged when c is finite and not -0); signed-zero cases need k equal to the vector length.
conventions.alternatives: the same input evaluated by the model under a nearby hypothesis (another minimum alignment exponent, number of extra alignment bits or FMA size): which one the hardware matches localises a mismatch.

predictions.NVIDIA: computed by #eval of TensorCore.runBlocks in ozaki/scripts/targeted/TensorCoreCases.lean; models in TensorCore/TC/CanonicalDefs.lean, TensorCore/TC/CanonicalFormatDefs.lean
predictions.AMD: computed by #eval of MatrixCore.dotBits in ozaki/scripts/targeted/MatrixCoreCases.lean; models in amd/MatrixCore/MC/Models.lean

cases.purpose: Seven products 2047^2 (11-bit integers) in one A100 block FMA: the exact sum 29331463 needs 25 bits, so the FP32 output truncates it to 29331462.
cases.instruction: A100: mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k8.row.col.f32.f16.f16.f32 (HMMA.1688, k = 8, one block FMA); or m16n8k16 / WMMA m16n16k16 (two block FMAs of size 8) with the vector in k = 0..7
cases.mismatch_means: 0x4BDFC804 (29331464) means the final conversion rounds to nearest rather than truncating; any other value means that the FMA size, the alignment to F = 24 fraction bits or the exact sum inside the block FMA is wrong. This is the case that limits Ozaki slices to fewer bits on A100.

cases.purpose: Fifteen products 2047^2 and one 2047*2046 in one H100 block FMA of size 16: exact sum 67041297, truncated to 67041296.
